jd_text:
Enterprise BDR – India & SEA
Orbitly | Bengaluru (Indiranagar) | Hybrid, 3 days in office

Who we are
Orbitly is a no-code workflow automation platform used by 1,500+ companies in 30 countries to run approvals, onboarding and procurement. We raised our Series C last year and are now building an enterprise sales team for India and South-East Asia. You'll be one of the first four Enterprise BDRs, working directly with our Enterprise AEs and the Head of Sales, APAC.

What you'll own
- Outbound prospecting into enterprise accounts (₹500 Cr+ annual revenue) in BFSI, manufacturing and retail
- Multi-threading into IT, finance and operations leaders at Director level and above
- Booking qualified meetings for Enterprise AEs: the target is 12–15 SQLs a month
- Running discovery calls using MEDDICC to qualify opportunities
- Keeping every call, email and meeting logged in Salesforce
- Working account plans with your AE for 40–50 named accounts
- Sharing what you hear from the market with marketing and product

Must-haves
- 2+ years in B2B SaaS sales as an SDR, BDR or inside sales rep
- Proven quota attainment (we'll ask to see the numbers)
- Hands-on Salesforce experience: logging activity, managing opportunities, building simple reports
- Experience using ZoomInfo for account and contact research
- Comfortable with cold calling and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
- Excellent spoken and written English; Hindi is a plus

Nice-to-haves
- Experience selling to enterprise accounts or large Indian conglomerates
- Outreach.io or Salesloft
- Formal MEDDICC training
- Prospecting into Singapore, Malaysia or Indonesia

What we offer
- OTE ₹14–18 LPA (60:40 fixed to variable), uncapped commission
- Clear path to Enterprise AE in 18–24 months
- Health insurance for you and your family (₹10 lakh cover)
- Quarterly President's Club trips for top performers
- Your own learning budget and paid sales certifications

Hiring process
Recruiter call → Role-play cold call with a BDR manager → Meeting with an Enterprise AE → Final round with the Head of Sales, APAC

Orbitly is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every gender, caste, religion, region, disability status and sexual orientation, and we make hiring decisions based on skill and potential.

expectations.trap_notes: HubSpot is not the JD's CRM: don't write 'Salesforce/HubSpot' or 'CRM (Salesforce)'. Apollo is not ZoomInfo. All selling so far is to SMB retailers and distributors; don't imply enterprise accounts, ₹500 Cr+ companies or Director-level multi-threading. He qualifies on BANT, not MEDDICC. ₹1.2 Cr is pipeline created for AEs, not revenue closed, and 112% is meeting quota, not revenue quota. Title is Inside Sales Representative; the 'Top SDR' award name doesn't make the title SDR or BDR.
